description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 ne Rr. Dritan Hoxha prane Zogut te Zi, ne zonen e Laprakes. Apartamenti ndodhet ne ndertimin COLONNADE , godine multifunksionale.
Ndertimi eshte i ri ne faze perfundimtare, me fasade te ventiluar dhe rifinitura te cilesise se fundit dhe arkitekture moderne.
Zona ku ndodhet ka akses te shpejt me Qendren e Tiranes vetem 5 minuta,ndermjet Rruges se Durresit, dhe akses direkt me daljen e qytetit, te ish-sheshi Shqiponja dhe Unazen e Madhe.
Siperfaqet e apartamenteve variojne nga 60 m2 – 72 m2 ne kate dhe orientime te ndryshme.
Kane planimetri me organizim unik me strukture moderne.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in St. Dritan Hoxha near the Black Bird, in the Laprak area. The apartment is located in the COLONNADE building, a multifunctional building. The building is new in the final stage, with ventilated and refinished facades of the last quality and modern architecture. The area where it is located has quick access to the Center of Tirana in just 5 minutes, between Durres Street, and direct access to the exit of the city, to the former Shqiponja Square and the Great Ring. The surfaces of the apartments vary from 60 m2 - 72 m2 on different floors and orientations. They have unique layouts with modern structures.
